declined.reason: holdings is a collection, and whether exists means 'present' or 'non-empty' is undefined in the control language. Deciding that here would smuggle in a semantics change as an approval.

The expected_value is a literal fund identifier, but eq compares decimals: the evaluator resolves expected_value['value'] to a Decimal and returns UNEVALUABLE when it cannot. Approval may change only approval_state and compilation_sha256, so this cannot be repaired by approving it.

note: FROZEN TEST PACK, not the shipped control set. These are the eight controls the committed 2026-08-13/08-14 fixtures were approved under, effective 2026-08-14, copied here on 2026-08-17 so the tests that exercise canonicalisation, signing, roots, tampering, provenance and transition rules stop moving whenever business policy does. A newly compiled control is effective from its compile date and can never evaluate an older fixture, so a suite pinned to whatever ships today breaks on every recompile -- eighty tests did. The artifacts referenced here stay committed for exactly this reason.
